scope: Installer planning, local validation and subprocess argument behavior tested with doubles only.
properties_verified_offline: Default path targets deploy/Dockerfile.xxx and exactly one XXXUltimate coordinator.
Config mounted outside DATA as read-only; DATA survives stop/reinstall.
Environment parsed as literal data; no source/eval/shell expansion.
Secret values excluded from installer arguments, plans and error/status output.
Host Quant Python override does not replace image virtual environment.
PAPER mode/permissions and persisted pause retained; empty expected account id accepted.
Running legacy/other-project instances block install before and after build.
Config/Compose changes during build block up.
Explicit legacy path requires existing compose.json and never invokes configure.py.
Status uses container inventory only; stop warns about software protection interruption.
limitations: Docker is unavailable here; real Compose schema, image build and container startup remain unverified.
Plan used synthetic credentials only and does not verify account identity or grant financial authority.
Runtime remains responsible for account binding, broker reconciliation and operational readiness.
Conflict inventory covers the selected Docker daemon, not other hosts or unrelated native processes.
Config source must be readable by container UID 1000; installer does not change source permissions.
Container health indicates HTTP liveness only, not strategy profitability or operational readiness.
Secrets exist in Docker runtime environment metadata as with ordinary environment injection; installer does not print or persist their values.
